model.name: qwen3.8-27b (agent)
model.about: Alibaba Qwen3.8, 27B dense, FP8 as published by Qwen. Thinking mode off, so it answers directly like gpt-oss at low reasoning effort. Apache-2.0. A hybrid (linear-attention) model: vLLM's default of 256 sequences exceeds its state cache on a 48 GB card, hence --max-num-seqs 64.

answers.sql:
SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS channel, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customers
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND IS_ACTV = TRUE

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alerts
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alerts DESC, jurisdiction

SELECT
    br.BUS_ID AS branch_id,
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.BUS_ID, br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC

SELECT
    f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
    ROUND(AVG(f.MID_RT), 8) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1

SELECT
    MKT.DSPLY_NM AS market,
    COUNT(*) AS valuation_rows,
    SUM(F.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_mkt_val,
    SUM(F.BOOK_VAL1_AMT) AS total_book_val,
    SUM(F.CST_BSS_AMT) AS total_cost_basis,
    SUM(F.UNRLZ_GAIN_AMT) AS total_unrlz_gain,
    SUM(F.RLZD_GAIN_AMT) AS total_rlzd_gain
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D F
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT DT ON F.BUS_DT_K = DT.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT MKT ON F.MKT_K = MKT.MKT_K
WHERE DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY MKT.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_mkt_val DESC

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1,
       COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS ACCT_CNT
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1

SELECT
    br.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON t.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON t.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC, branch_city

SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'

SELECT
    AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate_usd_dec_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12
  AND f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number, COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR
SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS CUST_CNT FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1

WITH cust AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
),
active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS no_txn_cust_cnt
FROM cust c
LEFT JOIN active a ON a.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE a.CUST_K IS NULL

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_declined FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
       COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaints DESC, c.DSPLY_NM

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
       SUM(t.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fees DESC

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC, jurisdiction_name

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.LN_ID) AS loan_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.BUS_CD1 = 'MOBILE'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR

SELECT
    p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p
    ON f.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY p.DSPLY_NM

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND w.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE

WITH cnt AS (
  SELECT t.BR_K, b.RGN_CD1, b.DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS ATM_TXN_CNT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON t.BR_K = b.BR_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY t.BR_K, b.RGN_CD1, b.DSPLY_NM
),
rk AS (
  SELECT c.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RGN_CD1 ORDER BY ATM_TXN_CNT DESC, BR_K) AS RNK
  FROM cnt c
)
SELECT RGN_CD1, DSPLY_NM AS BRANCH_NM, ATM_TXN_CNT
FROM rk
WHERE RNK = 1
ORDER BY RGN_CD1

SELECT m.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
       SUM(a.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON a.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
       SUM(w.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1

WITH dt AS (
  SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
wire AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT w.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
  JOIN dt ON w.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE w.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
),
atm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
  JOIN dt ON a.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE a.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers
FROM wire w
JOIN atm a ON w.CUST_K = a.CUST_K

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR

SELECT DISTINCT DSPLY_NM AS branch_name
FROM bank_dwh.D_BR
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
ORDER BY branch_name

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

WITH bal AS (
  SELECT f.ACCT_K, d.CAL_DT, f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT IN (DATE '2025-06-30', DATE '2025-12-31')
),
piv AS (
  SELECT ACCT_K,
         MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30' THEN CLSNG_BAL_AMT END) AS bal_jun,
         MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31' THEN CLSNG_BAL_AMT END) AS bal_dec
  FROM bal GROUP BY ACCT_K
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS acct_cnt
FROM piv
WHERE bal_jun IS NOT NULL AND bal_dec IS NOT NULL
  AND bal_jun > 0
  AND bal_dec < bal_jun * 0.9

WITH cat AS (
  SELECT CMPLT_CTG_K, DSPLY_NM
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT
  c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
  ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.RSLTN_AT - f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT)) / 86400.0), 2) AS avg_days_to_resolution
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN cat c ON c.CMPLT_CTG_K = f.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE f.IS_RSLVD = TRUE
  AND f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT <  TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY c.DSPLY_NM

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT BUS_ID, VRSN_NBR, CUST_SGMNT_CD1, IS_CURR,
         LAG(CUST_SGMNT_CD1) OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY VRSN_NBR) AS prev_seg
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS changed_cust_cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND prev_seg IS NOT NULL
  AND CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS DISTINCT FROM prev_seg

WITH q AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K, d.QTR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cust_cnt
FROM (
  SELECT CUST_K
  FROM q
  GROUP BY CUST_K
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT QTR_NBR) = 4
) x

WITH d2025 AS (
  SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
disputers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
  JOIN d2025 dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE d.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
),
wire_custs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT w.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
  JOIN d2025 dt ON w.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE w.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers
FROM disputers d
WHERE d.CUST_K NOT IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM wire_custs)

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT IN (DATE '2024-06-30', DATE '2025-06-30')
),
base AS (
  SELECT f.LN_ID, d.CAL_DT, f.DYS_PST_DUE
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
  JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LN_ID) AS loan_cnt
FROM base
WHERE LN_ID IN (
  SELECT LN_ID FROM base WHERE CAL_DT = DATE '2024-06-30' AND DYS_PST_DUE = 0
)
AND LN_ID IN (
  SELECT LN_ID FROM base WHERE CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30' AND DYS_PST_DUE > 30
)

WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.CCY_CD1, f.ORGNL_AMT,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY f.ORGNL_AMT) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY f.CCY_CD1) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1,
       AVG(CASE WHEN rn IN ((cnt+1)/2, (cnt+2)/2) THEN ORGNL_AMT END) AS median_amt
FROM base
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY CCY_CD1

WITH mobile AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE c.BUS_CD1 = 'MOBILE'
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 THEN txn_cnt END)::NUMERIC
             - MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2024 THEN txn_cnt END))
             / MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2024 THEN txn_cnt END) * 100, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM mobile

WITH m AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR, MAX(d.CAL_DT) AS last_dt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT m.MTH_NBR,
       MAX(d.CAL_DT) AS last_snapshot_dt,
       SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
JOIN m ON m.MTH_NBR = d.MTH_NBR AND d.CAL_DT = m.last_dt
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY m.MTH_NBR

WITH new_cust AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND CUST_SNC_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND CUST_SNC_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
txn_cust AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS cust_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN new_cust n ON n.BUS_ID = c.BUS_ID
JOIN txn_cust x ON x.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
       COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30'
  AND (EFF_TO_DT IS NULL OR EFF_TO_DT >= DATE '2023-06-30')
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1

WITH cust AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, BUS_ID, CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
),
trf AS (
  SELECT w.CUST_K,
         SUM(w.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY w.CUST_K
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
         c.BUS_ID,
         t.total_amt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY t.total_amt DESC, c.BUS_ID) AS rn
  FROM trf t
  JOIN cust c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
)
SELECT segment_code,
       BUS_ID,
       total_amt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment_code, rn

WITH c AS (
  SELECT f.CCY_CD1, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
)
SELECT CCY_CD1,
       cnt,
       ROUND(100.0 * cnt / SUM(cnt) OVER (), 2) AS pct
FROM c
ORDER BY cnt DESC

WITH m AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR, COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT m.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
       m.cnt AS wire_transfers,
       SUM(m.cnt) OVER (ORDER BY m.MTH_NBR) AS running_total
FROM m
ORDER BY m.MTH_NBR

WITH trf AS (
  SELECT t.BUS_DT_K,
         t.CCY_CD1,
         t.AMT::NUMERIC AS amt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
fx AS (
  SELECT f.BUS_DT_K,
         f.CCY_CD1,
         f.MID_RT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND f.BS_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR'
    AND f.QUOT_CCY_CD1 <> 'EUR'
)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN t.amt
                ELSE t.amt / fx.MID_RT END) AS total_eur
FROM trf t
LEFT JOIN fx ON fx.BUS_DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K AND fx.CCY_CD1 = t.CCY_CD1

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED') / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_share_pct FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR ORDER BY declined_share_pct DESC, d.MTH_NBR LIMIT 1

SELECT w.CCY_CD1 AS currency, SUM(w.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_volume, COUNT(*) AS transfer_count FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY w.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY total_volume DESC

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS channel, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customers
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND IS_ACTV = TRUE

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alerts
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alerts DESC, jurisdiction

SELECT
    br.BUS_ID AS branch_id,
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON t.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.BUS_ID, br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC

SELECT
    f.CCY_CD1                                   AS currency,
    f.BS_CCY_CD1                                AS base_currency,
    f.QUOT_CCY_CD1                              AS quote_currency,
    ROUND(AVG(f.MID_RT), 8)                     AS avg_daily_rate,
    COUNT(*)                                    AS days
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1, f.BS_CCY_CD1, f.QUOT_CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT MKT.DSPLY_NM AS market,
       COUNT(*) AS valuation_rows,
       SUM(F.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_mkt_val,
       SUM(F.NET_ASST_VAL1_AMT) AS total_nav,
       SUM(F.CST_BSS_AMT) AS total_cost_basis,
       SUM(F.UNRLZ_GAIN_AMT) AS total_unrlz_gain,
       SUM(F.RLZD_GAIN_AMT) AS total_rlzd_gain
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D F
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT DT ON DT.DT_K = F.BUS_DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT MKT ON MKT.MKT_K = F.MKT_K
WHERE DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY MKT.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_mkt_val DESC

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1,
       COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS ACCT_CNT
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1

SELECT
    br.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON t.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON t.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC, branch_city

SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance,
       COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12
  AND f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number, COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR
SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS CUST_CNT FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS no_txn_cust_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
    WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
      AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  );

SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS category_name, COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaints DESC, category_name

SELECT
    c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    SUM(t.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fees DESC

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_dispute_txn_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC, jurisdiction_name

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.LN_ID) AS loan_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
WHERE c.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR

SELECT p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
       SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON f.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K AND p.IS_CURR
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY p.DSPLY_NM

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS sme_cross_border_wire_cust_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE w.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE

WITH cnt AS (
  SELECT b.RGN_CD1,
         b.BUS_ID AS BR_BUS_ID,
         b.DSPLY_NM AS BR_NM,
         COUNT(*) AS ATM_TXN_CNT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON b.BR_K = t.BR_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY b.RGN_CD1, b.BUS_ID, b.DSPLY_NM
),
rk AS (
  SELECT c.*,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RGN_CD1 ORDER BY ATM_TXN_CNT DESC, BR_BUS_ID) AS RNK
  FROM cnt c
)
SELECT RGN_CD1 AS REGION_CODE,
       BR_NM AS BRANCH_NAME,
       ATM_TXN_CNT
FROM rk
WHERE RNK = 1
ORDER BY RGN_CD1

SELECT m.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
       SUM(a.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON a.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY f.CUST_K
)
SELECT c.BUS_ID, t.total_amt
FROM t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K AND c.IS_CURR
ORDER BY t.total_amt DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1

WITH dt AS (
  SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
wire AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT w.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
  JOIN dt ON w.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE w.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
),
atm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
  JOIN dt ON a.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE a.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.CUST_K) AS both_cnt
FROM wire w
JOIN atm a ON w.CUST_K = a.CUST_K

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR

SELECT DISTINCT DSPLY_NM AS branch_name
FROM bank_dwh.D_BR
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
ORDER BY branch_name

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

WITH bal AS (
  SELECT f.ACCT_K, d.CAL_DT, f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT IN (DATE '2025-06-30', DATE '2025-12-31')
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS acct_cnt
FROM (
  SELECT ACCT_K,
         MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30' THEN CLSNG_BAL_AMT END) AS bal_jun,
         MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31' THEN CLSNG_BAL_AMT END) AS bal_dec
  FROM bal
  GROUP BY ACCT_K
) t
WHERE bal_jun IS NOT NULL AND bal_dec IS NOT NULL
  AND bal_jun > 0
  AND bal_dec < bal_jun * 0.9

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.RSLTN_AT - f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT)) / 86400.0), 2) AS avg_days_to_resolution
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE f.IS_RSLVD = TRUE
  AND f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT >= '2025-01-01'
  AND f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY c.DSPLY_NM

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT BUS_ID, CUST_SGMNT_CD1, VRSN_NBR, IS_CURR,
         LAG(CUST_SGMNT_CD1) OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY VRSN_NBR) AS prev_seg
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS changed_cust_cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND prev_seg IS NOT NULL
  AND CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS DISTINCT FROM prev_seg

WITH q AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K, d.QTR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cust_cnt
FROM (
  SELECT CUST_K
  FROM q
  GROUP BY CUST_K
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT QTR_NBR) = 4
) x

WITH d2025 AS (
  SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
disputers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
  JOIN d2025 dt ON dt.DT_K = d.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE d.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
),
wire_custs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT w.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
  JOIN d2025 dt ON dt.DT_K = w.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE w.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers
FROM disputers d
WHERE d.CUST_K NOT IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM wire_custs)

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT IN (DATE '2024-06-30', DATE '2025-06-30')
),
base AS (
  SELECT f.LN_ID, d.CAL_DT, f.DYS_PST_DUE
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
  JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b25.LN_ID) AS loan_cnt
FROM base b25
JOIN base b24 ON b24.LN_ID = b25.LN_ID
WHERE b25.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30' AND b25.DYS_PST_DUE > 30
  AND b24.CAL_DT = DATE '2024-06-30' AND b24.DYS_PST_DUE = 0

WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.CCY_CD1, f.ORGNL_AMT,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY f.ORGNL_AMT) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY f.CCY_CD1) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1,
       COUNT(*) AS n_transfers,
       AVG(CASE WHEN (cnt % 2 = 1 AND rn = (cnt+1)/2) OR (cnt % 2 = 0 AND rn IN (cnt/2, cnt/2+1)) THEN ORGNL_AMT END) AS median_amt
FROM base
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY CCY_CD1

WITH counts AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE c.BUS_CD1 = 'MOBILE'
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 THEN txn_cnt END)::NUMERIC
             - MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2024 THEN txn_cnt END))
             / MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2024 THEN txn_cnt END) * 100, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM counts

WITH m AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR, MAX(d.CAL_DT) AS last_dt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT m.MTH_NBR,
       MAX(d.CAL_DT) AS last_snapshot_dt,
       SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
JOIN m ON m.MTH_NBR = d.MTH_NBR AND d.CAL_DT = m.last_dt
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY m.MTH_NBR

WITH new_cust AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND CUST_SNC_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND CUST_SNC_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
txn_cust AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS cust_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN new_cust n ON n.BUS_ID = c.BUS_ID
JOIN txn_cust x ON x.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
       COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30'
  AND (EFF_TO_DT IS NULL OR EFF_TO_DT >= DATE '2023-06-30')
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_segment

WITH c AS (
  SELECT f.CCY_CD1, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
)
SELECT CCY_CD1,
       cnt,
       ROUND(100.0 * cnt / SUM(cnt) OVER (), 2) AS pct
FROM c
ORDER BY cnt DESC

WITH m AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR, COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT MTH_NBR, cnt AS wire_transfers, SUM(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY MTH_NBR) AS running_total
FROM m
ORDER BY MTH_NBR

WITH trf AS (
  SELECT t.BUS_DT_K, t.CCY_CD1, t.ORGNL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
fx AS (
  SELECT CCY_CD1, BUS_DT_K, MID_RT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D
  WHERE RT_TYP_CD1 = 'RT_A'
    AND BS_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR'
    AND BUS_DT_K BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN t.ORGNL_AMT
                ELSE t.ORGNL_AMT / f.MID_RT END) AS total_eur
FROM trf t
LEFT JOIN fx f ON f.CCY_CD1 = t.CCY_CD1 AND f.BUS_DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED') / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_share_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY declined_share_pct DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    w.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
    SUM(w.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_volume,
    COUNT(*) AS transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY w.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS channel, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customers
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND IS_ACTV = TRUE

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alerts
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alerts DESC

SELECT
    br.BUS_ID AS branch_id,
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON br.BR_K = t.BR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.BUS_ID, br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC, br.BUS_ID

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = (SELECT MAX(CAL_DT) FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-08-01' AND CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-08-31')
  AND f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC

SELECT
    f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
    AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_daily_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1

SELECT
    m.DSPLY_NM AS market,
    f.CCY_CD1  AS currency,
    SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT  d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT m ON f.MKT_K    = m.MKT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.DSPLY_NM, f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY market, currency

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS ACCT_CNT
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1

SELECT
    br.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON t.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON t.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC, branch_city

SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance,
       COUNT(*) AS n_accounts
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12
  AND f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number, COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR
SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS CUST_CNT FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS cust_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
    WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
      AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  );

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_declined FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
       COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaints DESC, c.DSPLY_NM

SELECT
    c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    SUM(t.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fees DESC

SELECT SUM(d.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE d.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
       COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC, jurisdiction_name

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.LN_ID) AS loan_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.BUS_CD1 = 'MOBILE'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR

SELECT p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
       SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON f.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K AND p.IS_CURR
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY p.DSPLY_NM

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.CUST_K) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
  ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
 AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
WHERE w.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND w.BUS_DT_K BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231

WITH cnt AS (
  SELECT t.BR_K, b.RGN_CD1, b.DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS ATM_TXN_CNT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON t.BR_K = b.BR_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY t.BR_K, b.RGN_CD1, b.DSPLY_NM
),
rk AS (
  SELECT c.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RGN_CD1 ORDER BY ATM_TXN_CNT DESC, BR_K) AS RNK
  FROM cnt c
)
SELECT RGN_CD1, DSPLY_NM AS BRANCH_NM, ATM_TXN_CNT
FROM rk
WHERE RNK = 1
ORDER BY RGN_CD1

SELECT
    m.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
    SUM(a.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON a.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH trf AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K,
         f.ORGNL_CCY_CD1,
         f.ORGNL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'COMPLETED'
    AND f.IS_RTRND = FALSE
),
per_cust_ccy AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, ORGNL_CCY_CD1, SUM(ORGNL_AMT) AS ccy_amt
  FROM trf
  GROUP BY CUST_K, ORGNL_CCY_CD1
),
per_cust AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, SUM(ccy_amt) AS total_amt
  FROM per_cust_ccy
  GROUP BY CUST_K
)
SELECT c.BUS_ID,
       p.total_amt
FROM per_cust p
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON c.CUST_K = p.CUST_K AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
ORDER BY p.total_amt DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
       SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1

WITH dt AS (
  SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
wire AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT w.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
  JOIN dt ON w.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE w.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
),
atm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
  JOIN dt ON a.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE a.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.CUST_K) AS both_cust_cnt
FROM wire w
JOIN atm a ON w.CUST_K = a.CUST_K

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR

SELECT DISTINCT DSPLY_NM AS branch_name
FROM bank_dwh.D_BR
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
ORDER BY branch_name

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

WITH bal AS (
  SELECT f.ACCT_K, d.CAL_DT, f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT IN (DATE '2025-06-30', DATE '2025-12-31')
),
piv AS (
  SELECT ACCT_K,
         MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30' THEN CLSNG_BAL_AMT END) AS bal_jun,
         MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31' THEN CLSNG_BAL_AMT END) AS bal_dec
  FROM bal GROUP BY ACCT_K
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS acct_cnt
FROM piv
WHERE bal_jun IS NOT NULL AND bal_dec IS NOT NULL
  AND bal_jun > 0
  AND bal_dec < bal_jun * 0.9

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS category_name,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_cnt,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.RSLTN_AT - f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT)) / 86400.0), 2) AS avg_days_to_resolution
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c
  ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE f.IS_RSLVD = TRUE
  AND f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT >= '2025-01-01'
  AND f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY c.DSPLY_NM;

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT BUS_ID, VRSN_NBR, CUST_SGMNT_CD1, IS_CURR,
         LAG(CUST_SGMNT_CD1) OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY VRSN_NBR) AS prev_seg
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS changed_cust_cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND prev_seg IS NOT NULL
  AND CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS DISTINCT FROM prev_seg

WITH q AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K, d.QTR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cust_cnt
FROM (
  SELECT CUST_K
  FROM q
  GROUP BY CUST_K
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT QTR_NBR) = 4
) x

WITH d2025 AS (
  SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
disputers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
  JOIN d2025 dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE d.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
),
wire_custs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT w.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
  JOIN d2025 dt ON w.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE w.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers
FROM disputers d
WHERE d.CUST_K NOT IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM wire_custs)

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT IN (DATE '2024-06-30', DATE '2025-06-30')
),
base AS (
  SELECT f.LN_ID, d.CAL_DT, f.DYS_PST_DUE
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
  JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b25.LN_ID) AS loan_cnt
FROM base b25
JOIN base b24 ON b24.LN_ID = b25.LN_ID
WHERE b25.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30' AND b25.DYS_PST_DUE > 30
  AND b24.CAL_DT = DATE '2024-06-30' AND b24.DYS_PST_DUE = 0

WITH base AS (
  SELECT t.CCY_CD1, t.ORGNL_AMT,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY t.ORGNL_AMT) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY t.CCY_CD1) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1,
       AVG(ORGNL_AMT) AS median_amt
FROM base
WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2)
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY CCY_CD1

WITH mobile AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE c.BUS_CD1 = 'MOBILE'
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 THEN txn_cnt END) - MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2024 THEN txn_cnt END)) * 100.0
             / MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2024 THEN txn_cnt END), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM mobile

WITH m AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR, MAX(d.CAL_DT) AS last_dt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT m.MTH_NBR,
       MAX(d.CAL_DT) AS last_snapshot_dt,
       SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
JOIN m ON m.MTH_NBR = d.MTH_NBR AND d.CAL_DT = m.last_dt
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY m.MTH_NBR

WITH new_cust AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND CUST_SNC_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND CUST_SNC_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
txn_cust AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS cust_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN new_cust n ON n.BUS_ID = c.BUS_ID
JOIN txn_cust x ON x.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
       COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30'
  AND (EFF_TO_DT IS NULL OR EFF_TO_DT >= DATE '2023-06-30')
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1

WITH cust_totals AS (
  SELECT w.CUST_K,
         SUM(w.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY w.CUST_K
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
         c.BUS_ID,
         ct.total_amt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY ct.total_amt DESC, c.BUS_ID) AS rn
  FROM cust_totals ct
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON c.CUST_K = ct.CUST_K AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT segment_code, BUS_ID, total_amt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment_code, rn

WITH c AS (
  SELECT f.CCY_CD1, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
)
SELECT CCY_CD1,
       cnt,
       ROUND(100.0 * cnt / SUM(cnt) OVER (), 2) AS pct
FROM c
ORDER BY cnt DESC

WITH m AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR, COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT MTH_NBR, cnt AS wire_transfers, SUM(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY MTH_NBR) AS running_total
FROM m
ORDER BY MTH_NBR

WITH trf AS (
  SELECT t.BUS_DT_K, t.CCY_CD1, t.ORGNL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
fx AS (
  SELECT BUS_DT_K, CCY_CD1, MID_RT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D
  WHERE CCY_CD1 IN ('RON','USD','GBP','CHF','HUF')
)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN trf.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN trf.ORGNL_AMT
                ELSE trf.ORGNL_AMT / fx.MID_RT END) AS total_eur
FROM trf
LEFT JOIN fx ON fx.BUS_DT_K = trf.BUS_DT_K AND fx.CCY_CD1 = trf.CCY_CD1

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED') / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_share_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY declined_share_pct DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
    SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_volume DESC
